name: Chronomancer: Singularity Core deals 50% Ranged Weapon Damage plus unhalved 2 + 0.25*SP + 0.12*RAP Arcane damage (#12753)
contract: Singularity Core 804438 states: Empower your Wand attacks to deal an additional $804437s2% (50%) Ranged Weapon
804437 uses Effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG (BP=1, Die=1 -> 2) and Effect 1
SPELL_EFFECT_WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE (BP=49, Die=1 -> 50%) with DmgClass RANGED and SchoolMask ARCANE.
Previously 804437 had no SP/RAP scaling (EffectWeaponDmg skips spell_bonus_data) and lacked
AscensionFlatAfterWeaponPercent, halving Effect 0's flat bonus under Effect 1's 50% weapon percent.
Three identical level-60 Chronomancers equip Fire Wand 5069 (9-17 dmg) and trigger 804437 five times via
Artificer's Wand 561064 against a level-55 Harvest Golem. CoA.MonsterResistance (Enable=1, PerLevel=1,
PerPercent=5) together with Destiny Weaver open-world scaling (view level 56) otherwise gives the golem
56 Arcane resistance (11.2% average partial resist in 10% discrete steps in Unit::CalcAbsorbResist), which
pulls the 5-hit sp_plus mean to ~101.4 (below 104) and rap_plus mean to ~207.9 (below 224). All three
actors therefore hold beeg spellpen 823764 (e0 aura 123 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE -9998 across magic
schools 126, permanent; e1 is SpellFamilyName 33 only and cannot affect Chronomancer family 28), and setup
checks assert spell_resist_chance == 0 on Arcane (school 6) and spell_resist_total == 0 on every 804437
arm: base (0 SP, base RAP <= 80 -> 12-16, band 6-32), sp_plus (+400 SP -> +100 unhalved -> 112-116, band
104-136), and rap_plus (+1000 RAP -> +100 from 50% normalized ranged weapon damage plus +120 unhalved
tooltip RAP bonus = +220 -> 232-236, band 224-256). Pre-fix (~14 / ~14 / ~114), halved flat (~11 / ~61 /
~171), and doubled coefficients all fall outside these disjoint bounds.
